mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees at Verona City Hall. Look up at 5:47 PM to see the International Space Station passing from the Cross Plains area toward Madison near Home Depot for about 4 minutes.

The City of Verona is planning facility improvements. The Public Works and Utilities Department is looking to expand to better serve our growing population, while road construction continues on Mark Drive and Legion Street to improve traffic flow and safety.
There are currently no local events scheduled for the next 30 days, so stay tuned for future community updates.
In our weekly police report, on November 9, an officer stopped a vehicle on Highway 18/151 that was swerving, resulting in the driver being arrested for O W I, their third offence.
Today's flavor is the delightful Double Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
